verdict.rationale: Slack's huddles page says users can connect over audio or video and share screens inside Slack. It also says huddles let teams collaborate and co-create live, which directly covers screen sharing during a call. The evidence is only a short marketing statement. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of screen-sharing behavior (e.g. multi-sharer, annotation/drawing, admin controls), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration

citations.quote: Instantly connect over audio or video and share screens so you can get more done where you're already working.
Bring the feeling of working side-by-side to a virtual space that lets you collaborate and co-create live.
